seed.$description: Brand seed color (Material teal) driving ColorScheme.fromSeed for both the light and the dark M3 scheme. Carried over 1:1 from the hand-written theme.dart seed (spec flutter-design-tokens); the seed IS the token — all other scheme roles stay M3-derived (design.md D4).

semantic.$description: Semantic status colors with explicit light and dark sets. Cross-frontend shared tokens; NOT consumed by Flutter in this change (scheme roles stay seed-derived per design.md D4).

light.$description: Success status color on light surfaces.

dark.$description: Success status color on dark surfaces.

light.$description: Warning status color on light surfaces.

dark.$description: Warning status color on dark surfaces.

light.$description: Error status color on light surfaces (M3 error tone).

dark.$description: Error status color on dark surfaces (M3 error tone).

light.$description: Info status color on light surfaces.

dark.$description: Info status color on dark surfaces.
